name: Cassie Cage led the new-generation Special Forces squad
notes: Mortal Kombat X Story Mode introduces Cassie Cage as the leader of the four-person new-generation squad with Jacqui Briggs, Takeda Takahashi, and Kung Jin. Cassie's MKX biography independently places her in a Special Forces unit. This Fact records the role at this point in the Reboot timeline rather than storing command status as timeless Character metadata.
